summary: Iteration 48 — Verified 4 new Lumo features: Affiliate Shop (/shop + admin CRUD), OrderService live-tracker success screen, Provider Register explainer, and ProviderHub Instant payout. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass — public shop endpoints (products/retailers/categories/click), admin CRUD guards (unauth+customer blocked, admin CRUD flow works), wallet/withdraw responds 200 for provider. Frontend: all requested data-testids present. Confirmed: /shop renders with page-shop/shop-search-input/shop-retailer-bar; 25 seeded product cards; retailer chips (all/amazon/best_buy/wayfair/target/walmart) filter correctly; featured strip shows exactly 3 items when All+no query and hides when a retailer or query is set; product click calls POST /api/shop/click/{id} and opens affiliate URL in a new tab (verified popup url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09B8V1LZ3); shop-disclosure at bottom. NavBar nav-shop present for guest and customer, absent for provider. Marketplace: 'Earn cashback while you shop' text is gone, marketplace-shop-teaser + marketplace-shop-link (href=/shop) present. Register: role=provider then Continue reveals register-provider-explainer wrapping provider-explainer; role=customer path does NOT render register-provider-explainer. OrderService: submitting /order/cleaning as customer@lumo.test returns order-success with 3 pulsing (animate-ping/animate-pulse) elements + order-track-live linking to /jobs/{id}/track + order-see-requests fallback. ProviderHub as provider@lumo.test: provider-instant-payout button in header, click triggers /api/wallet/withdraw and shows toast 'Instant payout requested — $540.00 on the way to your bank'.

ui_bugs.issue: When a retailer/query filter is applied, `rest` still excludes featured items but the featured strip is also hidden — result: 6 Amazon products in backend render as only 5 cards (Amazon Echo Dot, the featured one, disappears). Fix: when a filter/query is active, include featured products in `rest` (e.g. `rest = (retailer||q) ? products : products.filter(p=>!p.is_featured)`).

Spec requires the Instant payout button to be DISABLED at $0 balance and show an info toast when clicked at $0. Actual: wallet chip in header reads '$0.00' but the button is enabled and clicking it calls /api/wallet/withdraw which returns a success toast for $540.00. Either (a) the wallet header value is stale/wrong, or (b) the disabled-at-zero guard isn't wired. Reconcile balance source-of-truth and gate the button (or backend) accordingly.

action_items: Fix Shop.jsx `rest` memo so featured items still render when a retailer chip or search query is active (currently the Amazon-featured Echo Dot vanishes when Amazon chip is clicked).
Reconcile ProviderHub wallet balance display vs Instant payout behavior: header shows $0.00 but backend paid out $540. Either surface the real balance in header, disable the button at $0, or both.
Optional: debounce shop search input so filtering happens as user types (currently requires Enter/Submit — works but discoverability is low).
critical_code_review_comments: Shop.jsx `rest` memo (line 64) conflates two concerns; splitting featured vs grid based on whether any filter is active would be clearer and prevent the missing-card bug.
shop.py aggregate pipelines for /retailers and /categories don't apply the same 60-item pagination as /products — fine for now but worth capping in case seed grows.

ProviderHub instant payout appears to always post the *cached provider balance* rather than a live re-read; racing with a concurrent withdraw could double-pay. Consider server-side atomic set-to-zero on withdraw.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (feature-coverage: all requested data-testids found; 2 behavioral gaps flagged)
